loss_reduction: Actual native F.cross_entropy on selected logits uses mean over accepted samples; no multiplication by acceptance fraction.
entropy_scope: weighted entropy recovered as closed_group minus labeled_CE minus .16*U_CE; float32 residual, not directly logged entropy.
gradient_scope: Only existing combined train/grad_backbone metric; not L/U gradient decomposition, layer gradients or proof of causal transfer.
inference: Coverage is not a loss multiplier. Scalar loss ratios do not establish parameter-gradient ratios or suggest a larger lambda automatically.
